wa_a_blackstone_blackstone_curve.notes: CATALOG DEFECT: not an independent line. Mountain Project (shared Dec 21 2025, 1 vote) describes it as a traverse/linkup: starts up BLM-1, crosses Stepping Stones to The Big Easy, curves back through Stepping Stones and finishes at the BLM-1 anchor (a 'rope drag experiment'). All three are their own rows on this wall (wa_a_blackstone_blm_1, wa_a_blackstone_stepping_stones, wa_the_big_easy). The Exit 32 guidebook's Blackstone list does not include it. Owner call: keep as a linkup row or drop. Nothing locked. MP facts for reference only: 5.10c, 85 ft (26 m), 11 bolts, chain anchor with lower-offs, FA Leland Windham (2/2000); stored grade 5.10c / length 26 already match. Access fix NOT proposed for this row until the owner decides whether it stays.
